title: StatsBomb open data

automated_access.note: Public GitHub, README invites research use

redistribute.note: Agreement 1.2.1 bars providing the data to any external or third party

derivative.note: Agreement 1.4 and README require the StatsBomb logo credit on any published analysis

notes: 418 Premier League matches (2015/16 all 380, 2003/04 Arsenal 38), zero with 360 data. Local-use only: derived artefacts must stay out of the deployed bundle. No publication date stated, so recency is the as_of date. Agreement footer says terms last updated 8 September 2023. Excerpts hashed from the pypdf text layer, where spaces are missing.

excerpts.locator: LICENSE.pdf p.1, clause 1.2.1 (pypdf extraction, words run together)
excerpts.paraphrase: The user may not edit, distribute, reproduce, sell or in any way provide the data to any external or third party.
The user may not commercially exploit the data or any analysis derived from using the service.
Any publication of analysis built from StatsBomb data must credit StatsBomb with its brand logo.

title: Wyscout public soccer-logs dataset (Pappalardo et al.)
notes: Seven competitions; England league wyId 364 labelled "English first division", 380 matches, events only, coordinates 0-100. No publication date stated, so recency is the as_of date. The collection record has no licence field; the licence sits on each article, so the check was done on the events article.
